item8_cells.label: M
item8_cells.scope: GPU_TRACE_OWNERSHIP coefficient_words = base (pre-LDE) M31 cells committed per tree; composition/quotient and FRI trees not included
item8_cells.reconciliation: 53.39 G (construction-cost) == preprocessed + main + interaction base cells over the 33 nodes (this run: 53.391 G). The '~37 G main+interaction' census-v2 figure counted the interaction tree at half its committed M31 columns (measured main+interaction = 48.744 G; main + interaction/2 = 32.44 G per this run).

item7_device_memory.label: D
assumptions: base cells, LDE and composition arena scale linearly with segment rows (all components grow with the segment)
composition arena is evaluated on 2x the trace domain (eval_log = trace_log + 1, measured) and does not grow with FRI blowup
streamed commit working set measured 3.8 GB (bank + scratch) at 2^23 LDE leaves; scales with LDE leaves
3 GB runtime reserve: context, ~1.9 GB kernel stack reservation, setup cache 2.1 GB is extra when resident

item6_d2.label: D/E
assumptions: native b4 doubles LDE + Merkle + quotient-commit work; those are 50-70% of native kernel time [E]
leaf cells that scale with the query count are 55-80% of a leaf [E: hashing is ~85% of leaf cells, decommit dominates hashing]
folds verify outer (q108) proofs, unchanged by D2; only leaves shrink
D2 also changes the native profile -> new named profile + soundness note (profiles stream)
item6_d2.recommendation: net saving in GPU-s on 24628607 across the whole assumption band, but SMALL (0.1-2.8 GPU-s of ~30: native kernels are ~5 GPU-s, leaves ~13). Recommend D2 = YES as an M7 candidate, gated on: (a) an in-circuit per-origin Blake count confirming the query-scaled share >= 55%, (b) the device-memory model (b4 doubles native LDE: 2^22 b4 fits, 2^23 b4 only with streamed commit), (c) a named profile + soundness note. Native wall rises; it is not on the M6 critical path if stage-2 overlaps leaves.

item3_blake.label: D (analytic; not an in-circuit count)
item3_blake.profile: q108 b2 fold4, 2^22 CPU segment, LDE depth 23
item3_blake.caveat: stwo mixed-size Merkle hashes column values at their own layer; this model charges ceil(C/16) per query per tree plus deduplicated 2-to-1 path nodes. PP/composition column counts are estimates. The exit gate (origins >= 95% of in-circuit Blake rows) needs a per-origin counter in the leaf graph builder (owned by canon-vk/hint-tape); spec in M40-FINDINGS.md.
